i dont know if i did anything wrong, but i messed with some settings to get my first test of the example to work fine, this is my edit: `upscale(
    input_file_path='input_test.mp3',
    output_file_path='output_test.flac',
    source_format='mp3',
    target_format='flac',
    max_iterations=50,
    threshold_value=0.8,
    target_bitrate_kbps=900,
    toggle_normalize=True,
    toggle_autoscale=True,
    toggle_adaptive_filter=False,
)` my resulting flac when analyzed ended with a bitrate of like 5300 and the sample rate was like 250khz

comments.body: looking on it with new eyes, i think that this is also making the adaptive filtering very very very slow, that is why i had it turned off before because it takes so long. also if this helps anything with the development aspect of things im using an rtx 3060 laptop gpu, not a powerhouse but it works fine with cuda 12 and 13 (although my drivers are on 12 right now). not that i would think that cuda speeds up the adaptive filtering very much anyway on account of it using sequential dependencies.
yeah so ive been sitting on it for about 30 minutes now and its getting stuck on applying adaptive filtering on the test track which is only like 15 seconds
